provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: exhaustion over all triples of 4-qubit stabilizer states, via a pivot and two quotients

notes: Settles chi(|H>^4) = 4 with the verified rank-4 decomposition, both directions machine-checked, and reproduces the value of Bravyi, Smith and Smolin from scratch. Every rank-3 triple over the 36720 four-qubit stabilizer states is excluded: 8.69 million collinear-in-quotient candidates arise and every one is three states of a single two-dimensional stabilizer subspace, whose span cannot contain the target once rank 2 is excluded in the same pass; no independent collinear triple exists at all. The exclusion is numerical and rests on a margin: the closest any two key-adjacent non-parallel quotient directions come to parallel is 0.9877 against a threshold of 1 - 1e-6, and the certificate refuses to print its claim if that clearance falls under 0.01. The H-type state at m=3, whose rank-3 decomposition is verified on the board, is the positive control.
